column1: # Reviewed CodeQL alerts that scripts/codeql-local.sh lets through.
# rule<TAB>path prefix<TAB>text in the alert's source<TAB>why it is safe
# A source reads "<source file>: <text>" (scripts/codeql-allow.jq), so a text that
# starts with a file allows that source only from that file. An alert passes only
# when every source it names matches an entry for its rule and path. Keep
# entries narrow, and give each one a reason a reviewer can check. Everything

column4: The CLI runs as the user; HOME and REMEMBER_* name the user's own files.

column3: src/fileio.c: user input (buffer read by read)
column4: The "input" is random_hex's /dev/urandom bytes, hex-encoded into a temp-file suffix (fileio.c).
The plugin fixtures go under XDG_DATA_HOME, which test_main.c sets to a mkdtemp directory before each test.
The harness runs the binary under test, named on its own command line.
The sqlite3 fixture runs test SQL on a test path, both shell-quoted by shell_quote_append.
Test files live under make_temp_db_path()'s mkdtemp directory (0700).

column4: The line is the user's own ~/.remember/default-db (plan 27), checked by copy_regular_db_path and opened with the user's rights, like --db.

column4: The brain path, from --db or the user's own ~/.remember/default-db (plan 27); events_log_skipped appends to <brain>.d/hooks.log with the user's rights, O_NOFOLLOW | O_NONBLOCK, and only to a regular file.
